title: Sigurnost imovine i podataka
summary: Klasifikacija podataka i imovine, zahtjevi rukovanja, sanitizacija po NIST SP 800-88, vlasništvo i inventar, uloge nad podacima (owner, controller, processor, custodian), retention i remanence, EOL/EOS, data states, scoping i tailoring, DRM, DLP, CASB i CNAPP.
summary_en: Data and asset classification, handling requirements, sanitization per NIST SP 800-88, ownership and inventory, data roles (owner, controller, processor, custodian), retention and remanence, EOL/EOS, data states, scoping and tailoring, DRM, DLP, CASB and CNAPP.
